trackCleanupButton.nothingToCleanUp: Nothing to clean up — this track already looks right.

units.hybridHint: "Hybrid" shows each step climb in whichever unit it was actually planned in — feet for a standard level, meters for a route crossing into airspace (e.g. China) that assigns levels in meters — rather than converting everything to one unit.
units.appLanguageHint: "System" follows your OS's own language, falling back to English if this app doesn't have a translation for it yet. Translation is being rolled out one part of the app at a time — most of the UI is still English regardless of this setting. Real aviation terms (ILS, STAR, SID, FL, QNH, ICAO idents) and anything from SimBrief always stay in English.
units.mapLanguageHint: The language of place names on the Track and Logbook maps. "Local" shows each place in its own language — independent of the app language above.
units.metarWindSpeedHint: The raw METAR text on Dispatch always stays as reported — this only controls a separate formatted wind line shown alongside it.
units.landingDistancesHint: Distance from threshold and centreline offset on a Logbook flight's landing card, and its touchdown diagram. Touchdown rate stays fpm and speeds/wind stay knots regardless.

credentials.description: Used by Dispatch to fetch and generate plans on SimBrief.

gsx.description: Attach GSX Pro's catering/fuel/handling receipts to matching flights in your Logbook. Windows only (GSX itself is Windows-only) — off by default, and nothing here shows up until enabled.
gsx.pathHint: Usually %APPDATA%\Virtuali\GSX\Receipts. A path that's wrong or no longer exists just means no receipts are found — never an error.
gsx.currencyHint: GSX totals convert using a live rate fetched at the time you view them — nothing is stored converted.

data.description: Import or export your fleet and logbook as local files.
data.fleetHint: Registration, type, operator and current airport. Importing skips registrations you already have.
data.logbookHint: A summary of every completed flight, with its landing — not a full backup (no route or OFP data). Import reads WingLog's own files, and SimToolkitPro CSVs.

cloudSync.description: Sync Fleet and Logbook across your machines. This is WingLog's own service, not a third party — off by default, nothing leaves this device until you log in.
cloudSync.signupHint: Signup isn't public yet — this only works with an invite code from the app owner.
